uncultured.finding: Another 2017 Facebook reply screenshot again preserves names, reply order, timestamps, likes and phone UI. This confirms the archival screenshot media-class pattern but adds little independent evidence because it belongs to the same platform/time family.
uncultured.candidate: Context-preserving screenshot capture remains a media-specific visual habit candidate, not yet a general visual grammar.

terminus.finding: A 2018 New Taipei migrant-worker governance interview supplies empirical support for the function-versus-tool candidate: hospital nurse-station education produced limited results, so officials shifted intervention directly toward potential employers while preserving the same preventive function. A 2009 Guishui Street interview set adds strong observational material on familiarity, place attachment, neighborhood relations and stigma, but largely confirms existing representation/exclusion veins.
terminus.candidate: The function-versus-tool vein is stronger because it now has an empirical non-elder-care case in which the visible intervention channel changes while the institutional function persists.
terminus.next: seek a counterexample where changing the tool also changes or dissolves the underlying function

phase: small-batch mining with provenance-first, genre-aware scoring, media-class separation and active falsification
